entries.canonical_text: Just One KISS — You Wanted the Best? You Got the Best!
Free all-day July 25, 2026 show at Cycle Moore Legacy, 11075 US 31 South, Interlochen, MI. No ticket required; RSVP is appreciated.
Free show · July 25, 2026 · Cycle Moore Legacy · Interlochen / US 31
You wanted the best? You got the best!
A free theatrical rock tribute day at Cycle Moore Legacy with campground energy, a pavilion stage, full lighting, loud music, bright lights, fog, and flashing patterns.
Independent theatrical rock tribute. No outside partnership is claimed or implied.
One towering Gene Simmons tribute attraction. Tight cues, hard light, smoke in the air, and no dead space.

July 25, 2026 in Interlochen on US 31. The show is free. Overnight camping is $10 per night, or regular Cycle Moore charges apply for stays more than one night before or after the event. Get the July 25 drop for schedule reminders, camping notes, parking, access notes, safety details, and the Facebook event link as the day draws near.
Camping $10/night; regular charges for longer stays
Pavilion stage and full lighting setup
Parking marked on grass inside the campground
Family-friendly warning: this is a family-friendly event, but loud sound, bright lights, fog, and sequences of flashing lights and patterns may be used. Sensitive guests should plan accordingly.
A stage takeover, not a polite cover night.
Just One KISS is an independent theatrical rock tribute built for fans who want transformation, smoke, chrome, fire-colored light, giant attitude, and that “you had to be there” feeling.
Black leather thunder, chrome glare, smoke curling low, and the kind of arrival that makes the pavilion feel like an arena.
Big chorus energy, fists up, faces lit red and gold, and every fan pulled into the ritual before the night lets go.
No casual bar-band drift: cues, drops, visuals, and full theatrical intent.
Armor shine, fog bursts, hard shadows, and a stage picture built to look dangerous even when every cue is under control.
No hunting. Get Cycle Moore Legacy arrival notes, all-day schedule reminders, camping and parking notes, safety/access updates, Facebook event link updates, and photo/video sharing instructions.
No ticket required: RSVP is appreciated. Parking is inside the campground, around the pavilion, on the grass as directed, and it will be clearly marked.
Photos, video, fan posts, and stage drops
Fan vault chats and gallery drops
No spam. Safety and access notes are folded into the main event, arrival, media, and Fan Vault drops.
Required: I agree to receive Just One KISS show updates.
The Fan Vault is where the crowd keeps the night alive: targeted fan posts, photos, clips, arrival tips, Q&A, chats, routing, and useful notes from people headed toward the same fire.
Just One KISS · July 25, 2026 · Free show · Interlochen on US 31. Independent theatrical tribute presentation; no outside partnership is claimed.
